pundit.name: Landon Donovan
pundit.take:
**Look, I get why people say drafting DR Congo in the fourth round shows optimism, but bless Bubba G's heart, that's just football poetry in the wrong language.** I feel for Gunner, who's sitting pretty at the top with 47 points, but it's clear his roster decisions are a high-stakes game of Russian roulette. DR Congo's performance against England didn't exactly set the world on fire, and although France was a solid Tier 1 pick, yesterday's zero against Belgium's stout play must have smarted. 

On the flip side, Devin, or "Ghost Pepper," seems to be locked in a strange romance with mediocrity. I mean, what can you expect when Haiti is your dark horse? Still, his Spain side has the strength to edge out Mustard Boy's Austria, especially after yesterday's solid win by the USA over Bosnia. Not that Zach's choices inspire much confidence, mind you. Brazil might be the jewel in his crown, but Austria isn't exactly Europe’s finest heavyweight. So, in today's matchup in Toronto, I'm confidently predicting Spain will take the win—not because Devin is a tactical genius, but because Zach's roster is in desperate need of a savior.
